slot_classification_method: Per-material-slot, not blanket. Vendor glTF base colours are classified by luminance and max-minus-min channel spread in linear light (DARK_L=0.045 rubber, DARK_METAL_L=0.13 + neutral -> exhaust, BRIGHT_L=0.55 + neutral -> hardware), so engine castings keep functional per-face finishes while painted castings take John Deere green. Per-slot evidence: reports/astra-preview/astra-preview-slot-inventory.json; run record: reports/astra-render-execution.json.
